ipAddress.description: The IP address of the Amazon Route 53 health checker, which will try to check the health of the endpoint.

region.description: The region of the Amazon Route 53 health checker.

statusReport.description: A description of the status of the health check endpoint as reported by one of the Amazon Route 53 health checkers.

checkedTime.description: The date and time that the health checker performed the health check in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

title: A type contains the health check result of the end point as reported by one of the Amazon Route 53 health checkers.
name: AwsHostedZoneHealthCheckObservation
